title: 공증사무 이의신청사건의 처리에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:9:0:00012:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 9 (Handling of Objection Case and Notification of Result)
(1) Where the Minister of Justice deems an objection well-founded, the Minister shall revoke the measure taken by the chief prosecutor of the district prosecutors' office and exercise supervisory authority over the notary public concerned pursuant to Article 79 of the Act or request the Notary Public Disciplinary Committee to make a disciplinary resolution pursuant to Article 82 (1) of the Act; where the objection is deemed groundless, the Minister shall dismiss it.
(2) When an objection case has been handled, the Minister of Justice shall notify the objector, the notary public concerned, and the chief prosecutor of the competent district prosecutors' office of the result.
(3) Article 7 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the processing period for objection cases handled by the Minister of Justice.
